info.name: GAIL GAS - MRA MeterReading.svc (complete)
info.description: All implemented MeterReading.svc/json actions and invoice methods. Set baseUrl, userName and password, run Login_V1, then set regional/customer/bill variables from real records. Readable bodies are automatically encrypted using the server WCF format; responses are verified and decrypted in Tests/Visualize. Uses Postman built-in crypto-js. Upload requests require choosing local files. Run selected workflows: write aliases are alternatives and a full collection run repeats writes/password changes. See src/docs/mra-mobile-postman.md for setup, limitations and cURL use.
